note: Matthew's wavelet inputs require the complete recording, including future samples. This is retrospective classification; a target day's raw signal alone is insufficient.

LA change is next-day minus current-day circadian amplitude. Recording day 13 has a missing LA change to avoid the final buffer's endpoint-sensitive amplitude; the model fills this using a median learned from its fitting data. All target days remain included.
Matthew's 37.2 °C and 15 counts/minute thresholds were chosen during development exploration and frozen before this run. Validation scores after feature design are exploratory.
